title: Lunita Laredo
html_source:
Molly’s mother’s name, Lunita, would translate to English as “little moon” of Laredo. Bloom didn’t know much about and there are hints of a family secret she won’t tell him. (G&S)
The moon is commonly used as a symbol of feminine nature and the menstrual cycle.
